FROM analysis.array_dimensions

rules.message: buckets overlap in tick range, so the layout they declare is not a partition
rules.sql:
SELECT a.session_id, a.clock_id, a.time_bucket_tick AS earlier_bucket, a.hi,
  b.time_bucket_tick AS later_bucket, b.lo
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, clock_id, time_bucket_tick, MIN(t_tick) AS lo, MAX(t_tick) AS hi
  FROM analysis.spike_events
  GROUP BY session_id, clock_id, time_bucket_tick
) AS a
JOIN (
  SELECT session_id, clock_id, time_bucket_tick, MIN(t_tick) AS lo, MAX(t_tick) AS hi
  FROM analysis.spike_events
  GROUP BY session_id, clock_id, time_bucket_tick
) AS b ON a.session_id = b.session_id
  AND a.clock_id = b.clock_id
  AND b.time_bucket_tick > a.time_bucket_tick
WHERE b.lo <= a.hi

JOIN core.sessions AS s ON s.session_id = e.session_id
WHERE e.clock_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.reference_clock_id

rules.message: sample_rate_hz disagrees with the time axis step
rules.sql:
SELECT a.array_asset_id, a.sample_rate_hz
FROM core.array_assets AS a
JOIN core.array_dimensions AS d USING (array_asset_id)
JOIN core.clocks AS c ON c.clock_id = d.clock_id
WHERE a.sample_rate_hz IS NOT NULL
  AND d.step_tick_num IS NOT NULL
  AND ABS(
    a.sample_rate_hz
    - COALESCE(
      c.tick_rate_hz,
      CAST(c.tick_rate_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(c.tick_rate_den AS DOUBLE PRECISION)
    )
    * CAST(COALESCE(d.step_tick_den, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)
    / CAST(d.step_tick_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION)
  ) > 1e-6

rules.sql:

FROM core.clock_anchors
GROUP BY clock_id
HAVING MAX(anchor_index) <> COUNT(*) - 1
  OR MIN(anchor_index) <> 0

rules.message: anchor sequences do not increase together, so interpolation is undefined
rules.sql:
SELECT clock_id, anchor_index
FROM (
  SELECT *, LAG(t_tick) OVER (PARTITION BY clock_id ORDER BY anchor_index) AS prev_t,
    LAG(parent_tick) OVER (PARTITION BY clock_id ORDER BY anchor_index) AS prev_p
  FROM core.clock_anchors
) AS derived_1
WHERE prev_t IS NOT NULL
  AND (t_tick <= prev_t OR parent_tick <= prev_p)

rules.message: an anchor gap exceeds twice the median, leaving ticks the mapping does not define
rules.sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  SELECT clock_id, anchor_index,
    CAST(t_tick AS DECIMAL(38,0))
      - CAST(LAG(t_tick) OVER (PARTITION BY clock_id ORDER BY anchor_index) AS DECIMAL(38,0)) AS gap
  FROM core.clock_anchors
),
typical AS (
  SELECT clock_id, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gap) AS m
  FROM gaps
  WHERE gap IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY clock_id
)
SELECT g.clock_id, g.anchor_index, g.gap, t.m
FROM gaps AS g
JOIN typical AS t USING (clock_id)
WHERE g.gap IS NOT NULL
  AND g.gap > t.m * 2

WHERE c.tick_zero_utc IS NOT NULL
  AND s.session_start_time IS NOT NULL

FROM core.clocks AS c
WHERE c.transform_slope IS NOT NULL

  FROM core.clock_anchors AS a

rules.message: a clock is its own ancestor, so walking the chain does not terminate
rules.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE up(clock_id, ancestor, depth) AS (
  SELECT clock_id, parent_clock_id, 1
  FROM core.clocks
  WHERE parent_clock_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u.clock_id, c.parent_clock_id, u.depth + 1
  FROM up AS u
  JOIN core.clocks AS c ON c.clock_id = u.ancestor
  WHERE c.parent_clock_id IS NOT NULL

)

FROM up
WHERE ancestor = clock_id
  OR depth >= 64

JOIN core.sessions AS s USING (session_id)

WHERE o.clock_id IS NULL

  FROM core.clock_anchors AS a
  WHERE a.session_id = c.session_id
    AND a.clock_id = c.clock_id

  FROM core.sessions AS s
  WHERE s.session_id = c.session_id

rules.message: a clock does not reach the session's reference clock, so it cannot be converted to it

WITH RECURSIVE up(clock_id, ancestor, depth) AS (
  SELECT clock_id, clock_id, 0
  FROM core.clocks
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u.clock_id, c.parent_clock_id, u.depth + 1
  FROM up AS u
  JOIN core.clocks AS c ON c.clock_id = u.ancestor
  WHERE c.parent_clock_id IS NOT NULL
    AND u.depth < 64

  FROM up AS u
  WHERE u.clock_id = c.clock_id
    AND u.ancestor = s.reference_clock_id
)

WITH unit_windows AS (
  SELECT o.unit_id, o.start_tick, o.stop_tick
  FROM core.unit_observation_intervals AS o
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u.unit_id, c.start_tick, c.stop_tick
  FROM core.units AS u
  JOIN core.clock_observation_intervals AS c ON c.session_id = u.session_id
    AND c.clock_id = u.clock_id
  WHERE NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1
    FROM core.unit_observation_intervals AS o
    WHERE o.unit_id = u.unit_id
  )
),
observed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT unit_id
  FROM unit_windows
)
SELECT s.session_id, s.unit_id, s.t_tick
FROM core.spike_events AS s
JOIN observed AS k ON s.unit_id = k.unit_id
LEFT JOIN unit_windows AS w ON s.unit_id = w.unit_id
  AND s.t_tick BETWEEN w.start_tick AND w.stop_tick
WHERE w.start_tick IS NULL

rules.message: unit_id is not dense from 0, or does not number a curation's units consecutively by label
rules.sql:
SELECT numbered.unit_id
FROM (
  SELECT unit_id, sorting_run_id, curation_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY unit_id) - 1 AS dense,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY sorting_run_id, curation_id
      ORDER BY label_length, local_unit_label, unit_id) - 1 AS rank_in_curation
  FROM (
    SELECT unit_id, sorting_run_id, curation_id, local_unit_label,
      CHARACTER_LENGTH(local_unit_label) AS label_length
    FROM core.units
  ) AS labelled
) AS numbered
JOIN (
  SELECT sorting_run_id, curation_id, MIN(unit_id) AS first_id
  FROM core.units
  GROUP BY sorting_run_id, curation_id
) AS curations
  ON curations.sorting_run_id = numbered.sorting_run_id AND curations.curation_id = numbered.curation_id
WHERE numbered.unit_id <> numbered.dense
   OR numbered.unit_id <> CAST(curations.first_id AS DECIMAL(38,0)) + numbered.rank_in_curation
